paragraphs: Mar, son of Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi.
This is how he is cited in Yuchasin, referring to [Ketubot 69a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.69a.13); in our Gemaras it reads only “the son of Rav Sama bar R' Ashi.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara distinguishes Mar son of Rav Ashi from the unnamed son of Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi. [Heilprin’s heading](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2425&lang=en) gives Mar as Rav Sama’s son, as Hyman reports from Yuchasin. The exact Yuchasin edition remains uncollated here.

[Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Ketubot.69a.13.1) places Rav Sama’s death during Rav Ashi’s lifetime. [Tosafot Rid](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_Rid_on_Ketubot.69a.4) places it after Rav Ashi’s death and after division of the estate. [Ritva](https://www.sefaria.org/Ritva_on_Ketubot.69a.5) objects to the earlier chronology, and [Penei Yehoshua](https://www.sefaria.org/Penei_Yehoshua_on_Ketubot.69a.6) proposes reading “after him” in Rashi, referring to Rav Ashi.
